# Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.SourceGenerators

Roslyn generators for [Notify], commands, routes, persist, auth.

NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.SourceGenerators
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress
License: MIT
Version: 0.6.1-preview (`--prerelease`)

## Use when

The app already uses Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Core and wants generated properties/commands/AOT registration.

## Do not use when

The app only needs CommunityToolkit.Mvvm [ObservableProperty].
